title: AionUi puts multiple coding agents in one always-on workspace
friendlyTitle: AionUi brings many coding agents into one app
summary: AionUi is an open-source desktop workspace for running and coordinating more than 20 command-line agents, including Hermes, Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode. It has about 31,600 GitHub stars and was among the day’s strongest AI-related trending repositories.
friendlySummary: AionUi is a free desktop app that can run Hermes, Claude Code, Codex and many other AI agents together.
whyItMatters: Use it when you want one interface for several local agent tools, scheduled work and team-style delegation. Review each agent’s permissions before enabling always-on operation, especially around repositories and credentials.
friendlyWhyItMatters: It can reduce tool switching and help organise several agents. Limit what each agent can access before leaving it running.
